name: Sind Woodpecker
rangeDescription: Arid woodland and desert scrub of southeastern iran to pakistan
description: Only black-and-white woodpecker in most of its range. Note the big white shoulder patches and white bars on the black back.

name: Javan Sunbird
rangeDescription: Java
description: Medium-sized sunbird of foothill forest and forest edge on Java; uncommon to rare in upper montane and lowland habitats. Forages actively in pairs, mixed flocks, or singly.

name: Ussher's Flycatcher
rangeDescription: Sierra leone to ghana and nigeria
description: An unusual small, chunky flycatcher. At a distance, looks entirely dark, but a good view reveals a slightly paler throat and a dark undertail with paler fringes.

name: Orange-winged Pytilia
rangeDescription: Central ethiopia and southern south sudan, uganda, rwanda, burundi, southern republic of the congo (lower congo river valley), southern democratic republic of the congo, tanzania, angola, zambia, and malawi southward to far northeastern namibia, northern and eastern botswana, northeastern south africa (limpopo), and south-central mozambique
description: Unusual and pretty member of the waxbill family. Shows fine olive-green barring below, yellow edges to the wing feathers, and red on the tail.

name: White-headed Bulbul
rangeDescription: Montane forest of southern myanmar to northwestern thailand
description: Unmistakable gray bulbul with a striking white head, rose-red bill, and orange vent. Passingly similar to white-headed forms of unrelated Black Bulbul but lacks shaggy crest, dark vent, and inky-black body of that species.

name: Slender-billed Tyrannulet
rangeDescription: Arid northeastern colombia to northwestern venezuela (zulia, falcón, and northern lara)
description: Very active, a small, greenish-brown flycatcher with yellowish underparts. Shows a short bill with orange base, faint whitish eyebrow, and contrasting white wing bars.

name: Bahama Nuthatch
rangeDescription: Grand bahama island; now critically endangered or extinct
description: Endemic to Grand Bahama Island, where it is the only nuthatch, though now extremely rare and possibly extinct. Active in crowns of pines and hard to see clearly.

name: Zamboanga Bulbul
rangeDescription: Southern philippines (basilan and zamboanga peninsula of western mindanao)
description: A medium-sized bird of foothill forest and edge in western Mindanao and on adjacent islands. Dark brown above with a grayish-brown streaked crown, a white belly, white under the base of the tail, and a warm reddish-brown throat, cheek, and chest.

name: Tepui Goldenthroat
rangeDescription: Tepuis of southern venezuela and adjacent brazil (roraima)
description: Medium-sized green hummingbird with a rounded, white-tipped tail and decurved black bill, found only in the tepui region of Venezuela and Guyana. Female is very similar to male but with some spotting on the green underparts.
imageCreditName: Lars Petersson | My World of Bird Photography

name: Rodrigues Fody
rangeDescription: Rodrigues (eastern mascarene islands)
description: A sparrow-like weaver. The mostly yellow breeding males are distinctive, but females and non-breeding males are drab.

name: Sierra Nevada Brushfinch
rangeDescription: Santa marta mountains (northeastern colombia)
description: Shy and skulking brushfinch restricted to cloud forest in Colombia’s Santa Marta Mountains. Quite distinctive in its limited range, with a black face and breast spot, white throat, and striped head.

name: Chinese Gray Shrike
rangeDescription: Mountains of eastern russia (amur region) to northeastern and central china
description: A beautiful silvery shrike with gray upperparts, white underparts, a black mask, and white in the wings. The white patches in the black wings and tail are especially conspicuous in flight.

name: Tanimbar Cuckoo-Dove
rangeDescription: Tanimbar islands (yamdena, larat, and selaru)
description: A large, long-tailed dove. Male is boldly patterned, with dark upperparts and pale underside, each extensively covered in dark barring.

name: Barred Hawk
rangeDescription: Montane forest of costa rica to colombia and northern ecuador
description: This montane raptor has very broad wings and a disproportionately short tail. The black hood is a good mark that stands out at a distance, but the namesake bars on the belly are thin and indistinct.

name: New Zealand Grebe
rangeDescription: North island (new zealand)
description: Relatively small, brown-black grebe endemic to New Zealand. Note the fine silvery back-swept feathers on the head and the distinctive yellow eyes.

name: Bare-necked Fruitcrow
rangeDescription: Southern venezuela and the guianas to northern bolivia and amazonian brazil
description: Unusual medium-sized bird of forest canopy in Amazonia. Dark blue overall with bare, wrinkly blue skin on the neck and a pale bill.

name: Orange-crowned Euphonia
rangeDescription: Colombia on both slopes of western andes (southward from southern chocó and risaralda), western ecuador, and extreme northwestern peru (tumbes)
description: Small finchlike bird, compact and short tailed with a stout bill. Male has notably orange-tinged underparts and dark upperparts with a purplish sheen.

name: Purple-breasted Cotinga
rangeDescription: Eastern colombia to southern venezuela, the guianas, and northern and eastern amazonian brazil
description: Medium-sized bird of rainforest canopy. Male unmistakable if seen in good light; female is conspicuously scalloped all over.

name: Green-naped Tanager
rangeDescription: Highlands of far eastern panama (darién) and adjacent colombia
description: This small tanager has a very limited range near the border of Panama and Colombia. Note the mostly black head with pale greenish spots on the cheek and nape, extensive dark spotting on breast and flanks, rich buffy belly, black back, and blue edges on wing feathers.

name: Olive-headed Weaver
rangeDescription: Mountains of southern tanzania, zambia, malawi, and mozambique
description: A localized woodland weaver that has a dusky-olive head and upperparts, and golden-yellow underparts. Brighter male has a golden-yellow crown and more extensive rusty breast patch.
